items.headline: Holders ~27% underwater — and still not selling
items.detail: MVRV 0.73: price is 27% below the crowd's avg on-chain cost basis ($0.498). Yet 56% of supply is in the longest-held tier — the float isn't moving.
items.framing: Maximum financial pain, minimal capitulation — conviction being tested and, so far, holding.
items.note: Describe the divergence, NOT a bottom call. "Not selling", not "buy".

items.headline: The valuation read is being pulled by sentiment
items.detail: The composite sits at the 13th percentile, but the sentiment axis is at 46 while the rest average 17 — the one dimension running hot.
items.framing: Everything is cheap except sentiment, which reads 46/100. That divergence is the story — it's how the exchange-flow build-up first became visible.
items.checkable: Each axis is a percentile of its own history; published weights on the Methods page.

items.headline: SPX's MVRV 0.73 = 2th percentile of Bitcoin's history
items.detail: SPX's MVRV of 0.73 sits at the 2th percentile of Bitcoin's entire MVRV history — as cheap as BTC's generational bottoms.
items.framing: MVRV is unitless, so it's comparable: SPX today is at BTC's 2th percentile. BTC was only this cheap at major bottoms.
items.note: A position on BTC's map, not a date-match forecast.

items.headline: NUPL -0.37 — capitulation
items.detail: Net unrealised profit/loss is -0.37 (from MVRV 0.73) — the market sits in the capitulation zone.
items.framing: Aggregate holder profitability. Below zero = the crowd is underwater, historically an accumulation zone.
items.note: A position read, not a signal.

items.headline: -86% below its long-run trend (Fire Sale band)
items.detail: Fair value for its age is $2.55; price sits -86% under it.
items.framing: Where today sits in the long power-law arc.

items.headline: 80% of all-time holders are gone — 92% of today's never sold to zero
items.detail: Of 27,124 wallets that ever held ≥5k SPX, 5,350 remain (80% churned). Yet 92% of CURRENT holders have never once sold to zero — survivorship.
items.framing: Enormous all-time churn, but the survivors are diamond-handed. The honest "who's still here" read.
items.note: Right-censoring: recent cohorts read high. "Gone" = fell below the 5k bar.

items.headline: Smart money still net-selling (-16.0% over 12w)
items.detail: The 10-wallet cohort of proven top-timers (ROI ≥5×, still holding) holds 6.84M SPX. 4w -1.8% · 12w -16% · 26w -21.2%.
items.framing: Smart money hasn't started buying yet (-16.0% in 12w). Honest "not the bottom signal yet" read.
items.checkable: A recomputed cohort of wallets with realized ROI ≥5× that still hold ≥50k SPX; net flow of their combined balance.

items.headline: 45% of supply is in profit
items.detail: 45% of tracked supply is held above its on-chain cost basis — low is a capitulation zone, high is euphoria risk.
items.framing: Deep value — most of the market is underwater.
items.note: A position read, not a signal.

items.headline: -1.3σ below its trend vs the alt market
items.detail: SPX ÷ the alt sector (ex-BTC/ETH/stables), detrended, sits 1.3σ below its own trend — cheap vs alts.
items.framing: Relative value vs the whole alt sector — -1.3σ cheap. SPX structurally outperforms alts, so this is deviation from ITS trend, not parity.
items.note: A relative-value position, not a signal.

items.headline: SOPR 0.883 — coins moving at a loss
items.detail: Spent-output profit ratio is 0.883: coins that moved on-chain realised a loss on average. Sustained <1 = capitulation, >1 = profit-taking.
items.framing: On-chain realised behaviour — loss-realisation (SOPR 0.883).
items.note: Only coins that MOVED; a behaviour read, not a signal.
